title: zones
description: Loads ZoneMinder zone definitions into a spatial index and passes frames through unchanged.

monitor_id.description: Monitor id recorded in the zone metadata.

frame_width.description: Frame width recorded in the zone metadata; 0 means take it from the frame header.

frame_height.description: Frame height recorded in the zone metadata; 0 means take it from the frame header.

zones.description: Wrapper object holding the zone list; the plugin looks for a zones array inside this value, so a bare array loads nothing.

items.description: One ZoneMinder zone row with PascalCase keys: Id, Name, Type, CheckMethod, Coords ("x,y x,y ..."), MinPixelThreshold (25), MaxPixelThreshold (255), MinAlarmPixels, MaxAlarmPixels, FilterX (3), FilterY (3), MinFilterPixels, MaxFilterPixels, MinBlobPixels, MaxBlobPixels, MinBlobs (1), MaxBlobs, AlarmRGB (16711680). Coords must have at least one point.
